summary: Verified Meta metrics readiness fix for Social Media Agent. All 10 backend tests passed. Frontend UI correctly displays MOCKED badges and status when insights scopes are not validated. The POST /api/social/metrics/refresh endpoint works correctly and returns clear responses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meta metrics readiness fix verified. The preview environment has a degraded Meta connection (connection_state=degraded, granted_scopes=[]) which is expected. The backend correctly: (1) recognizes insights scopes (instagram_manage_insights, read_insights, etc.), (2) marks 'Permissões para analytics' check as NOT OK when scopes missing, (3) returns metrics_mocked=true and live_metrics_ready=false in /api/social/status, (4) POST /api/social/metrics/refresh returns {ready: false, refreshed: 0, reason: 'Meta insights ainda não estão validados...'} when insights not ready. Frontend correctly shows 'Analytics MOCKED' badges and appropriate status text.
